service.name: Book a Mason
service.short_description: Book a verified Panun Kaergar mason by the hour, half-day, or full day for flexible on-site help with tools and skilled hands.
service.description: Book a Mason by Panun Kaergar lets you hire a verified mason for the time you need. Pick a 1-hour slot for quick fixes, 4 hours for medium jobs, or a full day for larger work. Your mason arrives with the right tools, reviews the task on site, completes work within the booked duration, and hands over neatly.

faqs.question: Are materials included?
faqs.answer: Labour is included for the booked duration. Materials such as paint, cement, tiles, or wood are typically supplied by the customer unless agreed otherwise.

faqs.question: What if the work takes longer than booked?
faqs.answer: Your mason will discuss any extra scope or additional time on site before proceeding.

faqs.question: Will the professional bring tools?
faqs.answer: Yes. Panun Kaergar masons arrive with standard hand tools. Specialist materials or equipment are confirmed separately if needed.

faqs.question: Which duration should I choose for Book a Mason?
faqs.answer: Choose 1 hour for small fixes, 4 hours for medium tasks like multiple fittings or patch work, and full day for larger projects.
